answer: A farm is only cheap while one proof serves many names. Verified court reporter registration with court reporters standing breaks that: a registration reporters keep after transcript audits. The tide an honest agent feels is a single short check; the hollow a farm feels is the same check a hundred times over, with no discount for volume. Each clone now carries a separate audit for every name, at about £40 a proof, so a hundred clones cost roughly £4,000 before they earn a penny, and the spiral is that the payout stays flat while the bill multiplies.
